Unify surfaces UVs based on a guide surface

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `UnifyUv`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Guide | `G` | Surface | Item |  | Guide surface to define UV orientation and domain |
| Surfaces | `S` | Surface | List |  | Surfaces to unify (list) |
| Shrink | `Sh` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Shrink surfaces to trimmed domain when possible |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Surfaces | `S` | Surface | List | Unified surfaces |
